unreachable.title: Couldn't reach Openship Cloud billing
unreachable.description: Your cloud session may have expired or the cloud is temporarily unavailable. Try again, or reconnect from Settings → Cloud.

notEnabled.title: Cloud purchases are not available yet
notEnabled.description: Openship has not enabled subscriptions and credit purchases yet. Please try again later.

notConfigured.title: Cloud billing setup is incomplete
notConfigured.description: Openship needs to finish setting up billing. Please contact Openship support.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to billing
forbidden.description: Ask your organization owner to grant you billing access.

signInRequired.title: Sign in to view billing

loadFailed.title: Couldn't load billing

plansRoute.changeViaSupport: Contact support to change this server’s plan. Your current subscription stays in place.

subscription.endsAtPeriodEnd: Renewal stopped. Your subscription ends at the end of the paid period.

subscription.error: Unable to update your subscription. Please retry.

deployGate.title: Choose a plan to deploy
deployGate.description: A paid Cloud plan is required to create projects, build your code and run apps.
deployGate.preserved: Your project settings stay here. Checkout opens in a new tab; return here after activating your plan to continue.
deployGate.loadError: Couldn't load your Cloud plan. Try again.
deployGate.ownerRequired: Ask your workspace owner to choose or manage your Cloud plan.
deployGate.ready: Your Cloud plan is updated. Close this window and try again.
deployGate.pending: Your plan hasn't changed yet. Finish checkout, then check again.
deployGate.creditsDescription: Add more usage or choose a larger plan to continue. Extra usage does not raise project, build time or service limits.
deployGate.paymentDescription: Update your payment or subscription details to continue deploying.
deployGate.pausedDescription: Cloud deployment is paused for this workspace. Contact support to restore access.
deployGate.upgradeDescription: Choose a plan with enough capacity, or adjust your project and try again.
deployGate.checkoutOpened: Checkout is ready in a separate tab. If it did not open, use the link below.

reasons.static-only: Your plan does not include this type of app. Choose a plan that supports it to deploy.
reasons.build-minutes-exhausted: You've reached your monthly build time limit. Choose a larger plan, or wait for your build allowance to reset.
reasons.free-subdomain-limit: You've used all the Cloud subdomains in your plan. Choose a larger plan, or remove an unused subdomain.
reasons.resource-tier: This project needs more CPU or memory than your plan allows. Choose a larger plan, or lower the resources in your project settings.
reasons.running-services: You've reached your running service limit. Choose a larger plan, or stop a service you no longer need.
reasons.project-limit: You've reached your project limit. Choose a larger plan, or delete a project you no longer need.

resourcesGuide.title: How Cloud usage works
resourcesGuide.creditsHint: Builds and running apps use credits for CPU, memory, disk activity and data transfer. Larger workloads use credits faster.
resourcesGuide.buildHint: Builds use the shared usage allowance according to their resource consumption. A separate time limit applies only when included in your saved plan.
resourcesGuide.appsHint: Reserved by deployed projects and queued deployments. Undeployed drafts don't use slots.
resourcesGuide.machineHint: The largest CPU and memory size available for one service. This is a limit, not a shared balance.
resourcesGuide.projectsHint: Projects saved in your workspace, including drafts.
resourcesGuide.routesHint: Public Cloud addresses for your apps.
resourcesGuide.setupHint: Choose a Cloud plan to create projects, build your code and run apps.
resourcesGuide.limitsHint: Projects, running services and any build time limit included in your plan.
resourcesGuide.balanceRule: Apps pause when the usage allowance runs out. Add more usage to continue, or upgrade for higher resource limits.
resourcesGuide.cpuHint: Processing used over time. 1 vCPU running for 1 hour is 1 vCPU-hour.
resourcesGuide.memoryHint: Memory used over time. 1 GB for 1 hour is 1 GB-hour.
resourcesGuide.diskHint: Data read and written by your apps. This is disk activity, not stored disk size.
resourcesGuide.networkHint: Data sent and received by your apps.
resourcesGuide.selectedRange: Credits used in this date range
resourcesGuide.usageHint: Actual CPU, memory, disk activity and data transfer for the selected dates.
resourcesGuide.invalidRange: Choose an end date on or after the start date.
resourcesGuide.usageSummary: Builds and running apps share a usage allowance. Larger machines and longer running times use more.
resourcesGuide.poolHint: Shared across all workspaces, including stopped workspaces and pending changes.
resourcesGuide.creditUnitsHint: Credits measure resource consumption, not minutes. CPU, memory, disk activity and transfer each have their own rate.
resourcesGuide.topupCapacityHint: Top-ups add usage credits. Upgrade your plan for more total CPU, RAM or storage.
resourcesGuide.planUsageNote: Builds and running apps share one allowance. How long it lasts depends on resource use. Apps pause when it runs out; add usage to continue.
resourcesGuide.poolNote: CPU, RAM and storage are shared across workspaces, including stopped workspaces and pending changes.

onboarding.workspaceDescription: Choose a plan to start building and running your apps.
onboarding.savedCreditsHint: Your prepaid usage stays in this workspace. Choose a plan to use it for Cloud deployments.
onboarding.checkoutNote: Review your payment details before subscribing.
onboarding.stepPlanHint: Choose the projects, services and build time you need.
onboarding.stepCheckoutHint: Your Cloud plan activates after payment.
onboarding.stepDeployHint: Create your project and press Deploy.
onboarding.usageDescription: Deploy on a paid plan to see your build and app usage here.
onboarding.paymentDescription: Add a payment method during checkout. You can manage it here after your first purchase.
onboarding.invoicesDescription: Your invoices and receipts appear after your first payment.
onboarding.topupsDescription: Your plan includes usage for builds and apps. Add more after your subscription is active.
onboarding.compareTitle: Find the right plan for your projects
onboarding.compareDescription: Compare projects, services, build time, and the CPU and memory available to each app.
onboarding.savedProjects: Saved projects in this workspace: {count}. Subscribe to add more.

resourceOverview.overviewHint: Your workspace’s usage, remaining allowance and plan limits.
resourceOverview.computeHint: CPU, memory, disk activity and app transfer share one allowance. Usage includes builds and running apps.
resourceOverview.cpuHint: 1 vCPU-h is one CPU core used for one hour. This measures work done, not app uptime.
resourceOverview.memoryHint: 1 GB-h is 1 GB of memory allocated for one hour.
resourceOverview.diskHint: Data read from and written to app disks. This is disk activity, not stored disk size.
resourceOverview.transferHint: Inbound and outbound data from your compute workloads. Edge delivery is shown separately.
resourceOverview.bandwidthHint: Incoming and outgoing traffic across your workspace’s edge routes. This monthly allowance is separate from compute. Routes pause at the limit until reset or upgrade.
resourceOverview.requestsHint: HTTP requests served through your workspace’s edge routes. These are visitor requests, not billing records or API calls.
resourceOverview.partialError: Some usage could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.

creditAlert.title: Cloud credits
creditAlert.lowDescription: You have used {percent}% of your allowance, including purchased credits. {credits} credits remain.
creditAlert.graceDescription: Your paid credits are used up. {credits} grace credits remain before new workloads are blocked.
creditAlert.exhaustedDescription: New deployments need more credits. Review this server’s billing options.
creditAlert.wrongOrganization: This billing link is unavailable for your account. Sign in with an account that belongs to the organization in the alert.

capacityEditor.title: Manage Cloud capacity
capacityEditor.description: Share your resource pool between projects. Review a smaller allocation to make room, or choose a larger plan.
capacityEditor.loadError: Could not read Cloud capacity. Please retry.
capacityEditor.applyError: Could not confirm the resource adjustment. Retry uses the same request.
capacityEditor.retryError: Could not restart deployment. Review its error and try again.
capacityEditor.restartNotice: These services may briefly restart when their shared workspace is resized. Changed services use their current images and saved settings.
capacityEditor.preserved: Persistent volumes are kept. No new source build is requested.
capacityEditor.allocationNote: Stopped workspaces still reserve capacity. Storage cannot be reduced here. Workspace allocations include Docker overhead and any build reservation.
capacityEditor.failed: The adjustment did not finish successfully. Check its deployment logs before retrying.
capacityEditor.timeout: Still waiting for confirmation. Check this operation again or open its logs.
capacityEditor.buildDescription: Builds use your pool’s available capacity. Set an optional cap; smaller builds may be slower or run out of memory.
capacityEditor.requestChanged: Resources changed. Retry checks the updated request against current capacity.
capacityEditor.buildUnavailable: This project no longer deploys to Cloud. Open its settings to adjust build resources.
capacityEditor.buildInvalid: Use at least 0.25 vCPU and 128 MB of memory.
capacityEditor.buildSaveError: Could not save build resources. Review the error and try again.
capacityEditor.imageOnly: Prebuilt images: no source-build resources are reserved.

unavailable.permission: Project and service write access is required to resize this workspace.
unavailable.busy: A deployment or cleanup is still running.
unavailable.not-deployed: Deploy this project before adjusting a running workspace.
unavailable.native-workspace: Change this Cloud workspace's resources from its project settings.
unavailable.unverified: This workspace allocation could not be verified.
unavailable.not-running: Start this workspace before resizing it.

custom.name: Custom
custom.title: Size your server
custom.description: Choose the CPU, memory, and storage your projects share.
custom.diskGrowth: Existing disks can grow. Shrinking storage requires moving your data to a new server.
custom.shared: One managed server for your projects and apps. A single service can use the full available capacity.
custom.invalid: Enter a valid amount within each resource range.
custom.quoteError: Couldn't update the price. Please retry.
custom.bestPrice: Bundle discounts apply automatically. You pay the lowest price for your chosen resources.
custom.rates: Monthly extras: {cpu}/vCPU, {memory}/GB RAM, {disk}/GB storage. Charged only above the selected bundle.
custom.applyNotice: After payment, review and apply the new resources. Applying them restarts projects on this server.
custom.resizeDescription: Your plan has changed. Review the new capacity and affected projects before restarting this server.
custom.applying: Updating server resources. You can follow progress on the server page.

workspaces.title: Managed Cloud servers
workspaces.savedDestinationHint: This project keeps its saved server and data.
workspaces.uploadDestinationHint: Source files are on this server. Start a new upload to use another destination.
workspaces.serverPlanDescription: Your new server has its own CPU, memory and storage, with a separate subscription.
workspaces.serverPlanReady: Your plan is active. Return to setup to deploy on this server.
workspaces.description: Choose a plan and deploy. Openship manages the server; your projects share its CPU, memory and storage.
workspaces.chooseBilling: Select a server to view its billing.
workspaces.dedicatedProjectsHint: Existing projects with their own Cloud machines.
workspaces.sharedHint: Projects and builds share one server’s capacity.
workspaces.dedicatedHint: One project and all its services in their own server.
workspaces.nativeHint: Run one compatible app directly. Multi-service apps use a Docker server.
workspaces.defaultHint: Choose a plan and deploy. We create and manage your server automatically.
workspaces.noneAvailable: Create a Cloud server to choose its plan and deploy.
workspaces.placementHint: Projects share this server’s capacity. Deleting one leaves the others in place.
workspaces.createHint: Choose this server’s plan next. Billing starts after checkout; setup is automatic.
workspaces.cloudOnly: Openship Cloud manages setup, routing and HTTPS for you.
workspaces.noProjects: No projects on this server yet.
workspaces.usageHint: Actual CPU, memory and storage used by this server.
workspaces.projectDiskHint: Approximate writable layers, volumes and project files. Images, build cache and system files are shared; totals can differ from filesystem usage.
workspaces.poolHint: Apps and builds share the purchased CPU, memory and storage. Adding a project does not allocate another server.

activity.noLogs: No logs were recorded for this operation.

workspaces.noResize: This server already has the plan’s capacity.
workspaces.restartHint: Running services in the projects below will briefly restart. Stopped services stay stopped. Disk data is preserved.
workspaces.deleteHint: Remove every project first and end the subscription. This permanently removes the empty server and its remaining disk data.
workspaces.buildCapacityHint: Builds use free capacity on this server. Stop an idle service or increase the server’s capacity, then retry.

network.title: Networking
network.description: Provider settings for this managed server.
network.internetHint: Allow apps and builds to download dependencies and reach external APIs.
network.routingHint: Manage these from each project. Routing, HTTPS and edge infrastructure are managed automatically.
network.confirmHint: This affects every project on this server. Disabling internet access can interrupt builds and external integrations.
